content: To show the validity of our word subspace representation for text classification and the proposed extension, we divided our experiment section into two parts: The first one aims to verify if sets of word vectors are suitable for subspace representation, and the second one puts our methods in practice in a text classification test, comparing our results with the conventional methods described in Section "Related Work" .
